instruction.text: Höre dir die Beschreibung zu New York und seinen Bezirken an. Tippe auf die beschriebenen Bezirke.

atoms.text: New York is a big city that has five separate parts.
atoms.sound: New York is a big city that has five separate parts.

atoms.text: Staten Island is in the southwest of New York. It is separated from the other parts by a channel called the Narrows.
atoms.sound: Staten Island is in the southwest of New York. It is separated from the other parts by a channel called the Narrows.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>channel</voice> bedeutet im Deutschen Kanal.

atoms.text: On the other side of the Narrows, in the center of the map, is Brooklyn.
atoms.sound: On the other side of the Narrows, in the center of the map, is Brooklyn.

atoms.text: Next to Brooklyn the biggest part of New York, Queens, is found. The peninsula in the south of New York also belongs to this district.
atoms.sound: Next to Brooklyn the biggest part of New York, Queens, is found. The peninsula in the south of New York also belongs to this district.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>peninsula</voice> bedeutet im Deutschen Halbinsel. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>district</voice> bedeutet im Deutschen Stadtteil.

atoms.text: In the north of New York you can find the part that is called the Bronx. It has a small riverside at the Hudson River.
atoms.sound: In the north of New York you can find the part that is called the Bronx. It has a small riverside at the Hudson River.

atoms.text: The last part of New York is called Manhattan. It is very slim with a long riverside at the Hudson River.
atoms.sound: The last part of New York is called Manhattan. It is very slim with a long riverside at the Hudson River.

atoms.text: Those were the five parts of New York. All of them are fascinating, but visitors and tourists often stay in Manhattan. It is the most popular part of New York because of its interesting neighbourhoods.

instruction.text: Lies die Texte über die bekanntesten Stadtviertel Manhattans. Beantworte die Fragen. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

atoms.text: Chinatown in New York is a hotspot for affordable Asian cuisine. It's famous for its cheap restaurants, street sellers and souvenir shops. Chinese lanterns and big billboards with Chinese letters express the busy atmosphere and authentic culture of this neighbourhood.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>affordable</voice> bedeutet im Deutschen kostengünstig oder preiswert.

atoms.a: What can you find in the streets?

instruction.text: Lies die Texte über die bekanntesten Stadtviertel Manhattans. Beantworte die Fragen. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

atoms.text: Harlem is a very historic neighbourhood. It is famous for its diverse African-American community, vibrant music scene, and iconic gospel music that resonates through its streets.

atoms.a: What kind of music is Harlem known for?

instruction.text: Lies die Texte über die bekanntesten Stadtviertel Manhattans. Beantworte die Fragen. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

atoms.text: Little Italy is centred around Mulberry Street, offering Italian culture and cuisine. However, far fewer people of Italian origin live here today than a hundred years ago. That is because many poor Italian immigrants became richer over time and were able to move to better neighbourhoods.
